fr:frontmatter.fr:meta: @misc{jiangRaggedPagedAttention2026, title = {Ragged {{Paged Attention}}: {{A High-Performance}} and {{Flexible LLM Inference Kernel}} for {{TPU}}}, author = {Jiang, Jevin and Chen, Ying and Hechtman, Blake A. and Zhang, Fenghui and Mu, Yarong}, year = {2026}, doi = {10.48550/arXiv.2604.15464}, urldate = {2026-05-04}, number = {arXiv:2604.15464}, publisher = {arXiv}, file = {/home/kellen/Downloads/papers/Ragged Paged Attention A High-Performance and Flexible LLM Inference Kernel for TPU - Jiang et al..pdf}, keywords = {Computer Science - Artificial Intelligence,Computer Science - Machine Learning,Computer Science - Performance}, langid = {english}, archiveprefix = {arXiv}, abstract = {Large Language Model (LLM) deployment is increasingly shifting to cost-efficient accelerators like Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), prioritizing both performance and total cost of ownership (TCO). However, existing LLM inference kernels and serving systems remain largely GPU-centric, and there is no wellestablished approach for efficiently mapping LLM workloads onto TPU architectures---particularly under the dynamic and ragged execution patterns common in modern serving. In this paper, we present Ragged Paged Attention1 (RPA), a highperformance and flexible attention kernel for TPUs, implemented using Pallas[2] and Mosaic. RPA addresses these challenges through three key techniques: (1) fine-grained tiling to enable efficient dynamic slicing over ragged memory, (2) a custom software pipeline that fuses KV cache updates with attention computation, and (3) a distribution-aware compilation strategy that generates specialized kernels for decode, prefill, and mixed workloads. Evaluated on Llama 3 8B[5] on TPU7x, RPA achieves up to 86\% memory bandwidth utilization (MBU) in decode and 73\% model FLOPs utilization (MFU) in prefill. Integrated as the primary TPU backend in vLLM[6] and SGLang[13], RPA provides a production-grade foundation for efficient TPU inference and offers practical insights into kernel design.}, primaryclass = {cs}, eprint = {2604.15464}, month = {April}, shorttitle = {Ragged {{Paged Attention}}} }
